doc: The building_shadows band (core/render/README.md 'Cast shadows'): the height cue of the 90-degree city. Every chunk shadow command (a building, prop or parked car silhouette the generator offsets down-right and flags as a shadow) draws on that band with one material: `shader` when it is in the tree (the d5-close lane's look_d5_shadow, its 'shadow' params proposal), else `fallback_shader` (this lane's D4 placeholder, the same uniforms). Both print as a light ink tint plus world-locked hand-drawn pen strokes that the look_d4 print then inks (the hatched cast shadows of the target frame). classes: offset_m = the cast distance down-right per texture class; the chunk data carries baked_offset_m (ChunkBuild.add), the view adds the rest, so no re-bake.
